name: Lily Zarr
bio: I'm a senior studying psychology, entrepreneurship, and Spanish. My interests in EA include government interventions and animal welfare. In my free time, I enjoy reading science fiction, hanging out with friends, and biking around St. Louis. I would love to chat about effective altruism and how you can get involved!

name: Steven Jeon
bio: I'm a junior at WashU studying political science and economics. My interests in EA include nuclear security and existential risks. In my free time, I enjoy playing fantasy football, walking around campus and listening to music.

name: Reed Trende
bio: I am a PhD student studying immunology at WashU and co-founded the club back in 2022. My research focuses on developing vaccines that inhibit virus transmission. I enjoy running, experiencing the outdoors, and listening to lots of diverse podcasts. Within EA, I'm most knowledgeable about biosecurity, as that is closest to the work I do day-to-day. However, my interests within EA are broad, spanning from philosophy to community building to mitigating nuclear risks. Please schedule a meeting with me here if you would like to chat!

name: Jon Bogard
bio: I am an Assistant Professor of Organizational Behavior. I study human judgment and decision-making, with an emphasis on perceptions of risk as well as social, moral, and political psychology. I'm both personally and professionally interested in effective altruism. I'm eager to connect with students who are excited to talk about research or EA, so please reach out!
